mapper.select: SELECT t.bus_no AS id, t.bus_no AS busNo, t.status_enum AS statusEnum, CASE t.status_enum WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '草稿' WHEN 'SUBMITTED' THEN '已提交' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '已审批' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '已驳回' ELSE t.status_enum END AS statusDesc, t.purpose_location_id AS warehouseId, o.name AS warehouseName, 'PHARMACY' AS stocktakeType, SUM(CASE WHEN t.profit_loss_price > 0 THEN t.profit_loss_price ELSE 0 END) AS totalProfitPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN t.profit_loss_price < 0 THEN ABS(t.profit_loss_price) ELSE 0 END) AS totalLossPrice, IFNULL(SUM(t.profit_loss_price), 0) AS profitLossPrice, COUNT(*) AS itemCount, t.applicant_id AS applicantId, app.name AS applicantName, t.apply_time AS applyTime, t.approver_id AS approverId, appr.name AS approverName, t.approval_time AS approvalTime, t.remake AS remark, MIN(t.created_at) AS createdAt FROM wkf_supply_request t LEFT JOIN adm_organization o ON o.id = t.purpose_location_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner app ON app.id = t.applicant_id AND app.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner appr ON appr.id = t.approver_id AND appr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.type_enum = 'INVENTORY_CHECK' AND t.bus_no = #{busNo} GROUP BY t.bus_no, t.status_enum, t.purpose_location_id, o.name, t.applicant_id, app.name, t.apply_time, t.approver_id, appr.name, t.approval_time, t.remake LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS id, t.item_id AS itemId, md.name AS itemName, md.total_volume AS specification, t.lot_number AS lotNumber, (t.total_quantity - t.item_quantity) AS bookQuantity, t.total_quantity AS totalQuantity, t.item_quantity AS itemQuantity, t.unit_code AS unitCode, t.unit_code AS unitName, t.price AS price, t.profit_loss_price AS profitLossPrice, t.remake AS remark FROM wkf_supply_request t LEFT JOIN med_medication_definition md ON md.id = t.item_id AND md.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.type_enum = 'INVENTORY_CHECK' AND t.bus_no = #{busNo} ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by, version, bus_no, original_bus_no, type_enum, status_enum, category_enum, intent_enum, priority_enum, summary_id, deliver_id, patient_id, item_table, item_quantity, total_quantity, item_id, unit_code, occurrence_time, practitioner_id, supplier_id, reason, source_type_enum, source_location_id, purpose_type_enum, purpose_location_id, approver_id, approval_time, applicant_id, apply_time, start_time, end_time, lot_number, trace_no, price, total_price, remake, profit_loss_price FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum = 'INVENTORY_CHECK' AND bus_no = #{busNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum = 'INVENTORY_CHECK' AND bus_no = #{busNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE wkf_supply_request SET status_enum = #{statusEnum}, applicant_id = #{applicantId}, apply_time = #{applyTime}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum = 'INVENTORY_CHECK' AND bus_no = #{busNo}
